issues.desc: CHK-003 only names Koala metadata, runtime artifacts, and one product-output unexpected path; it does not explicitly cover material source/config dirty rows, fixture dirty rows, or the actual TEST/DONE gate hint surface from CHK-002. Because this story touches lifecycle dirty gates, PLAN should add verification prep that proves categorized gate output is rendered while source/fixture/unexpected dirty files remain blocking.

CHK-001 and CHK-003 are framed as internal implementation/testing tasks rather than user-visible outcomes. The story outcome is clear, but these checklist items should ideally be phrased around the visible gate behavior users will experience, with tests as evidence rather than product checklist value.
